items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution increase
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026. Deemed delivery under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (as stated in the letter: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post') = 4th day after posting = Sun 22.11.2026; for social-law letters this deemed-delivery day itself does not shift even on a weekend. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) on Tue 22.12.2026, which is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies.

items.title: New monthly contribution takes effect
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 betragen Ihre monatlichen Beiträge 318,46 €.
items.computation: Date is explicitly stated in the letter as the start of the new contribution amount.

items.title: First direct debit at the new, higher rate (covers January 2027 contribution)
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The new rate applies from January 2027. Contributions are debited on the 15th of the month following the contribution month, so the first debit reflecting the new €318,46 rate (for January 2027) falls on 15.02.2027; 15.02.2027 is a Monday, a normal working day, so no shift applies.

warnings: The letter states a self-serving deemed-delivery rule ('vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post') consistent with § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X for social-insurance correspondence since 2025; if the person can show actual receipt on a later date, the Widerspruch period starts from that later date instead.
No explicit old contribution amount is given for comparison, so only the new amount (318,46 €) could be recorded; the increase itself cannot be independently verified from this letter alone.
